Add league tier and country metadata

Source: R/plot_theme.R
add_league_metadata.Rd

Augments a data frame containing league_code with tier and country columns. Top 5 leagues (E0, D1, I1, SP1, F1) are marked as "Top 5"; all others as "2nd Tier".

Usage

add_league_metadata(df)

Arguments

df

A data frame with a league_code column.

Value

The input data frame with tier and country columns added.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tibble::tibble(league_code = c("E0", "E1", "D1", "D2")) |>
  add_league_metadata()
} # }
